# Miyorare — Current Main (25 Sep 2026)

## ✨ New

- **Reader Journey** — a long-term reading progression system with verified completion-based Lifetime XP, levels/ranks, achievements, Reader Profile, selectable Reader Titles, and a bounded achievement showcase.
- **Journey cosmetics and celebrations** — rank-linked profile cosmetics, glow/frame/background/progress treatments, and optional milestone celebrations without locking core reading features.
- **Privacy-safe Year in Review** — annual reading summaries use aggregate statistics only and keep identifying manga/source metadata out of the share model.
- **Upgraded Novel / EPUB reader** — expanded typography controls including font, size, weight, line height, paragraph spacing, margins, alignment, and Light/Sepia/Dark/OLED reading presets.
- **More precise novel progress** — EPUB reading position can be restored much closer to the last paragraph/offset instead of only returning to the chapter.
- **Flexible novel translation tools** — translate selected text, a paragraph, or a full chapter while preserving the original text and chapter layout; the main APK remains lightweight without bundling a large on-device translation model.
- **New Miyorare Favourites experience** — adaptive themed backgrounds, neon/glass surfaces, Manga/Novel switching, category treatment, compact quick filters, and refreshed card/navigation visuals.

## 🔧 Improved

- **Reader Journey rules and privacy** — Incognito and Peek sessions are excluded, imported/mark-as-read history does not backfill XP, and reread rewards stay intentionally small and bounded.
- **Reader Journey performance** — stats/journey persistence is serialized and cancellable to reduce write storms, races, and unnecessary recomputation.
- **Navigation and visual consistency** — floating/legacy navigation behavior, dark/light readability, Details, Explore, Settings, categories, overlays, and other Miyorare surfaces received additional polishing.
- **Favourites performance and stability** — filtering, category handling, large-library interactions, background rendering, and visual regression coverage were hardened.
- **Novel reader stability** — EPUB chapter/position changes and asynchronous page prepending were hardened to avoid stale-position jumps and resume regressions.
- **Backup, Local, and Source Pack safety** — restore/local indexing paths, source compatibility checks, parser wiring, and promotion validation were strengthened.
- **Download UI stability** — download list interactions and scrolling behavior received additional stabilization work.
- **ExHentai / E-Hentai compatibility** — access, WebView URL handling, search/pagination diagnostics, and source compatibility were tightened without changing the existing download path.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Reader privacy race conditions** — disabling journey tracking or entering Incognito/Peek now also cancels pending session persistence so excluded activity cannot leak back into stats/journey state.
- **Reader Profile privacy guards** — profile data stays device-local, showcase choices remain bounded, and mature-content-safe achievement/share rules are enforced.
- **Favourites visual regressions** — geometry, spacing, card proportions, quick actions, and bottom-navigation reference checks were updated to the accepted Miyorare layout.
- **Promotion and Android 15 acceptance** — release-gate dependency resolution, shell execution, instrumentation invocation, deep unit tests, and Android 15 runtime acceptance were repaired and hardened before this promotion.
- **General regression hardening** — additional automated coverage now protects Reader Journey, Year in Review, Favourites, backup/restore, local storage, chapter persistence, source compatibility, and runtime performance.
